name: eqvps
title: EQVPS
description: VPS and code sandboxes that AI agents rent and operate over MCP: order and manage VPS; start Firecracker sandboxes, run code, move files — billed per second from one prepaid balance.

authentication.description: AI AGENTS (this MCP): call the register_account tool (token valid 1 year by default; refresh_token renews it) — the agent supplies its own credentials and receives a Bearer token immediately (no email, no OTP code, no human step). Send it as Authorization: Bearer <token>. Do NOT use the website email-OTP flow; that path is for humans in a browser only and an agent cannot complete it (cannot read email). Catalog tools (list_plans) are public.
authentication.tokenAcquisition: tool:register_account (agents get a Bearer token instantly — NOT the human email-OTP flow)
authentication.x-agentAuth: register_account tool -> Bearer token, immediate, no email/OTP/human step
authentication.x-humanAuth: website eqvps.com only: passwordless email OTP code, not usable by agents

tools.name: get_started
tools.description: Start here: the whole flow (VPS + sandbox) with example arguments, the only human step, common errors with fixes, and your current state.

tools.name: list_plans
tools.description: List available VPS plans with pricing, specs and OS images.

tools.name: register_account
tools.description: Create an EQVPS account (programmatic signup, no human in the loop). Returns a Bearer token.

tools.name: login
tools.description: Log in with email + password; returns a Bearer token.

tools.name: refresh_token
tools.description: Exchange the current API token for a new one before it expires (the old one is revoked).

tools.name: set_password
tools.description: Set a password for this account once, to enable email+password login as a recovery method.

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Return the authenticated account profile.

tools.name: get_balance
tools.description: Return prepaid credit balance and currency.

tools.name: topup_balance
tools.description: Create a crypto top-up invoice; returns a PayRam checkout URL.

tools.name: order_vps
tools.description: Order a VPS by plan slug + OS id (pays from prepaid balance).

tools.name: pay_invoice
tools.description: Initiate crypto payment for an owned unpaid invoice (invoice_id as returned, e.g. "2RUAWV4"); returns checkout URL.

tools.name: list_vps
tools.description: List the account's VPS services (id, status, plan).

tools.name: get_vps_status
tools.description: Full detail for one VPS: status, specs, live VM state/uptime, SSH/RDP access.

tools.name: power_vps
tools.description: Power-control a VPS: start, stop or reboot.

tools.name: set_hostname
tools.description: Set the VPS hostname (DNS label; applied on reboot/rebuild).

tools.name: reset_password
tools.description: Reset the VPS root password.

tools.name: reinstall_vps
tools.description: DESTRUCTIVE: wipe and reinstall the VPS with a given OS image.

tools.name: get_vps_metrics
tools.description: Time-series resource metrics (CPU, memory, network, disk) for a VPS.

tools.name: undo_cancel
tools.description: Undo a scheduled end_of_period cancellation — the VPS stays active and renews.

tools.name: get_upgrade_options
tools.description: Plans this VPS can switch to in place (resize / convert), with the prorated charge.

tools.name: change_plan
tools.description: Change the VPS plan in place (resize or NAT↔dedicated convert); data kept, one reboot; prorated charge from the balance.

tools.name: cancel_service
tools.description: Cancel a VPS. Default end_of_period (lives out paid term, no data loss); immediate wipes the VM+data NOW (needs confirm=hostname) and refunds unused paid days to your balance.

tools.name: delegate_service
tools.description: Grant operator access to one of your VPS to another person by email.

tools.name: accept_delegation
tools.description: Accept a delegation invitation (token from the invite link).

tools.name: list_delegations
tools.description: List delegations you granted on your services.

tools.name: list_delegated_to_me
tools.description: List services other owners delegated to you.

tools.name: revoke_delegation
tools.description: Revoke (or decline) a delegation by id.

tools.name: create_ticket
tools.description: Open a support ticket (subject, message, optional service_id).

tools.name: list_tickets
tools.description: List your support tickets with status.

tools.name: get_ticket
tools.description: Read a ticket and its full message thread (author: you/staff).

tools.name: reply_ticket
tools.description: Reply to one of your tickets.

tools.name: close_ticket
tools.description: Close a ticket; rating (1-5) and comment optional.

tools.name: sandbox_pricing
tools.description: Public: sandbox tariffs — micro 0.25 vCPU/512 MB RAM/3 GB disk · small 0.5 vCPU/1 GB RAM/5 GB disk · standard 1 vCPU/2 GB RAM/10 GB disk · plus 2 vCPU/4 GB RAM/15 GB disk · pro 4 vCPU/8 GB RAM/20 GB disk · max 8 vCPU/16 GB RAM/40 GB disk — with per-second/hour/month prices, the billing model and limits (synchronous exec up to 55 s, background tasks longer; files up to 5 MB per transfer; runtimes: Python 3.12 + pip, Node.js 22 + npm, bash, git, curl). No authentication needed. Writing code instead of calling MCP? Official SDKs on the same REST API and token: Python `pip install eqvps`, TypeScript/JavaScript `npm i @eqvps/sdk` (docs: https://eqvps.com/en/docs/sandboxes). Requires: nothing.

tools.name: create_sandbox
tools.description: Start an isolated Firecracker microVM sandbox (ephemeral per-second or persistent hourly), billed from the prepaid balance.

tools.name: run_code
tools.description: Run Python, Node.js or bash code in a sandbox; returns exit code, stdout, stderr (background: true for long jobs).

tools.name: exec_command
tools.description: Execute a shell command in a sandbox (background: true for jobs longer than 55 s).

tools.name: get_task
tools.description: Poll a background task: state, exit code and new output since the given offsets.

tools.name: kill_task
tools.description: Stop a background task.

tools.name: upload_file
tools.description: Write a file (text or base64, up to 5 MB) into a sandbox.

tools.name: download_file
tools.description: Read a small file (up to 5 MB) from a sandbox into the conversation.

tools.name: get_download_url
tools.description: Short-lived link to stream one sandbox file (up to 2 GB) — no base64 in context.

tools.name: get_upload_url
tools.description: Short-lived link to PUT one file into a sandbox (up to 2 GB, 95 MB per request with offset).

tools.name: list_sandboxes
tools.description: List the account's sandboxes (running and paused).

tools.name: get_sandbox
tools.description: Sandbox status plus usage and cost so far.

tools.name: kill_sandbox
tools.description: Delete a sandbox immediately and irreversibly (all data lost); billing stops.

prompts.name: rent_vps
prompts.description: Step-by-step: account → crypto top-up (one human payment) → order → wait for SSH → connect.

prompts.name: run_code_in_sandbox
prompts.description: Create a sandbox, install packages, run code (background for long jobs), clean up.

prompts.name: fix_ssh_access
prompts.description: Diagnose 'connection refused' / 'permission denied' on a VPS without breaking it.

x-guidance: Every tool response carries next_steps; every error carries error.code, error.fix and error.next. Start with the get_started tool.

x-eqvps.payment: crypto USDC/USDT on Base, Ethereum and Polygon, via PayRam
